instruction: `ds/ring.py::RingBuffer.to_list` returns elements in the wrong order after the buffer has wrapped around. It reads from index 0 instead of from the current head, so the oldest slot is reported first even when newer data should come first.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/ds/ring.py b/ds/ring.py
--- a/ds/ring.py
+++ b/ds/ring.py
@@ -49,5 +49,5 @@
     def to_list(self):
         out = []
         for i in range(self._size):
-            out.append(self._buf[i])
+            out.append(self._buf[(self._head + i) % self._capacity])
         return out
